Package gui

Class TabCurrentDinersController

java.lang.Object
gui.TabCurrentDinersController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Initializable
public class TabCurrentDinersController extends Object implements Initializable
Controller for the "Current Diners" tab in the restaurant management system. This class is responsible for displaying a real-time list of all customers (both Guests and Subscribers) who are currently seated in the restaurant. It manages a TableView that dynamically adjusts displayed information based on whether a customer is a registered subscriber or a walk-in guest.
